data.description:
## Context
Gerrit Verify uses same-change concurrency with cancel-in-progress=true, but the docs-only routing change 6f4123678c added job-level always() predicates to seven full-route jobs. GitHub re-evaluates those predicates during cancellation; because they remain true, stale matrix/reusable jobs are not canceled. In run pair 31834162663 -> 31834896849, the predecessor consumed 1,785 runner-seconds after the replacement existed and delayed successor job creation by 1,510 seconds.

The existing docs-only contract must remain fail closed: a classifier failure still launches the full fallback route and remains a blocking result. A superseding-patchset cancellation is a different state and must not launch or preserve stale full-route work.

## Plan
- Add a focused workflow-contract regression that is RED on the current job predicates and separately proves both branches: cancellation makes every full-route job ineligible; classifier failure while not canceled keeps every full-route job eligible.
- Replace only the cancellation status portion of the seven full-route predicates with a cancellation-aware status check, preserving the current clear-vote, ticket, classifier-result, and route conditions byte-for-byte otherwise.
- Keep the vote/finalization job cancellation-aware behavior unchanged so a canceled run is still normalized and reported.
- Run the focused workflow tests, actionlint/YAML policy gates, make lint, and make typecheck.
- Land through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Use the first genuine same-change replacement as live confirmation; do not manufacture extra runner usage solely for the experiment.
- Back out with a Gerrit revert if classifier-failure fallback or route aggregation regresses.

## Evidence and prior decisions
- GitHub cancellation reference, github/docs commit 81ade08c, lines 18-22: a running job whose if remains true is not canceled; always() is the explicit example.
- Home Assistant core 58a3fdb, Apache Airflow ef759de, and Grafana 9587636 combine cancellation concurrency with !cancelled() predicates for dependent/fan-in work.
- brainy-accused-wrasse requires classifier-failure full fallback; this change preserves it.
- smoky-flare-slug requires new patchsets to auto-cancel prior Verify runs.
- frowsy-beggarly-mammoth changes canceled-run diagnostics and does not reject prompt stale-run cancellation.
- No prior rejection of this remediation was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each full-route job becomes ineligible when the workflow run is canceled.
- [ ] Each full-route job remains eligible when the classifier fails and the run is not canceled.
- [ ] Each full-route job remains eligible for a successful full classification.
- [ ] A docs-only classification still skips all seven full-route jobs and runs the documentation lane.
- [ ] The seven job sets, OS/Python matrix cells, commands, assertions, and coverage behavior are unchanged.
- [ ] The vote job still runs and reports a canceled workflow.
- [ ] The regression oracle is observed RED before the workflow edit and GREEN afterward.
- [ ] A defect-seeded restoration of always() makes the oracle RED again.
- [ ] Focused workflow tests, actionlint/YAML checks, make lint, and make typecheck pass.
- [ ] Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 are recorded before merge.
- [ ] The merged SHA and timing are recorded.
- [ ] Live evidence from the first genuine same-change replacement shows stale full-route jobs conclude canceled and the successor is admitted without waiting for natural matrix completion.
- [ ] Runner savings are reported without claiming the live cancellation saving as successful-run average wall-clock improvement.
data.title: Cancel superseded Gerrit Verify full-route jobs promptly
